title: The Logarithmic Minkowski conjecture and the $L_p$-Minkowski Problem
abstract: The current state of art concerning the $L_p$ Minkowski problem as a Monge-Ampere equation on the sphere and Lutwak's Logarithmic Minkowski conjecture about the uniqueness of even solution in the $p=0$ case are surveyed and connections to many related problems are discussed.
